headline: Trilegal, JSA act on Infineon Technologies' acquisition of C2i Semiconductors
sum: Infineon Technologies AG has made a 100% acquisition of C2i Semiconductors Private Limited by way of purchase of all outstanding equity shares from the shareholders of C2i. Trilegal advised Infineon Technologies on this acquisition.
detail: Infineon Technologies AG has made a 100% acquisition of C2i Semiconductors Private Limited by way of purchase of all outstanding equity shares from the shareholders of C2i. Trilegal advised Infineon Technologies on this acquisition. The Corporate team was led by Kosturi Ghosh (Partner), with support ftom Ajeya BG (Counsel), Divya Upreti (Senior Associate) and Associates Raghav Kansal and Harsh Pati Tripathi. The Labour and Employment team was led by Veena Gopalakrishnan (Partner), with support from Vinduja Menon (Senior Associate) and Sarah Serrao (Associate).
